title: Algerian Nimble Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and healthy chicken tagine recipe, adapted with nimble ingredients. This dish showcases the rich flavors of Algerian cuisine.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add gherkin, nimble, and chicken broth. Stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and cook until chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional gherkin if desired.
Serve with couscous or rice, if desired.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days.
